title: DNA Binding Metal-Peptidic Helicates as Minimal Coiled-Coil Mimics
authors: Ben E. Barber; L. E. Cano; S. J. Coles; Samuel I. Fidler; L. J. McCormick Mc Pherson; C. T. McTernan
one_liner_zh: 该文设计金属-肽螺旋体作为卷曲螺旋模拟物，选择性结合DNA三叉连接，虽非TF-DNA体系，但涉及蛋白-DNA互作界面建模且方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Metal-organic helicates are precisely defined nanoscale assemblies which have been widely used in biological applications due to their high stability, ready synthesis, and selective interactions with DNA. However, most have been formed predominantly from rigid aromatic panels or single, continuous pseudopeptidic chains, limiting their specific interactions with biological systems and potential for variation. Coiled-coils are common structural motifs in DNA binding proteins, enabling precise orientation of DNA binding a-helices. Herein, we merge these two concepts, creating metal-peptidic helicates (c. 3 nm long) which form from three individual, defined, a-helical architectures, with precisely controlled chirality, bridging the typical length scale of metal-organic helicates (1 nm) and coiled coils (c. 10 nm). We synthesise of a series of novel M2L3 metal-peptidic helicates (M = Fe(II) or Ni(II)) using bipyridine functionalised, Aib stabilised, a-helices, in which metal coordination brings together three individual peptide chains in a chiral, supercoiled, structure reminiscent of coiled-coil domains. By changing bipyridine substitution site, the handedness of the helicate structure (ΔΔ or ΛΛ) can be switched independently of peptide sequence. We demonstrate that these helicates possess exceptional stability in water, and are capable of selectively binding DNA three-way junctions (3WJs) over other DNA secondary structures – offering a highly tunable platform for developing selective binders for biological applications.
abstract_zh: 金属有机螺旋体是精确定义的纳米尺度组装体，因其高稳定性、易于合成以及与DNA的选择性相互作用，在生物应用中广泛使用。然而，大多数螺旋体主要由刚性芳香面板或单一连续假肽链构成，这限制了它们与生物系统的特异性相互作用及变异潜力。卷曲螺旋是DNA结合蛋白中常见的结构基序，能够实现DNA结合α-螺旋的精确取向。在此，我们融合这两个概念，创建了金属-肽螺旋体（约3纳米长），由三条独立、明确的α-螺旋结构组成，具有精确控制的手性，桥接了金属有机螺旋体（1纳米）与卷曲螺旋（约10纳米）的典型长度尺度。我们利用联吡啶功能化、Aib稳定的α-螺旋，合成了一系列新型M2L3金属-肽螺旋体（M = Fe(II)或Ni(II)），其中金属配位将三条独立肽链聚集在一种手性、超螺旋结构中，类似于卷曲螺旋结构域。通过改变联吡啶取代位点，螺旋体的手性（ΔΔ或ΛΛ）可独立于肽序列进行切换。我们证明这些螺旋体在水中具有卓越的稳定性，并能选择性地结合DNA三叉连接（3WJs），优于其他DNA二级结构——为开发生物应用中的选择性结合剂提供了一个高度可调的平台。
